layout_notes: archer stands in the left third, bow raised at chest height, arrow flies across the middle and right of the frame; ground line runs along the bottom of the whole frame

parts.name: archer_torso
parts.how: line from neck to hips, slight lean
parts.notes: leans into draw, relaxes after loose

parts.name: archer_front_leg
parts.how: line hip to ground, braced forward

parts.name: archer_back_leg
parts.how: line hip to ground, braced back

parts.name: bow_arm
parts.how: line shoulder to bow grip, extended left-to-right

parts.name: draw_arm
parts.notes: pulled back at full draw, snaps open after loose

parts.name: bow_curve
parts.notes: deeply bent at full draw, springs nearly straight after loose

parts.name: bow_string
parts.notes: pulled back to draw hand at start, straight after loose

parts.name: arrow
parts.how: long thin line with small tip
parts.notes: nocked on string at start, detaches at loose, flies far right

parts.name: ground
parts.how: single horizontal line across the frame

keys.name: start
keys.archer: full draw, draw hand at cheek, torso leaning back slightly, bow deeply bent
keys.arrow: nocked, tail on string, tip pointing right

keys.name: loose
keys.archer: fingers open, draw arm starting back, bow springing straight
keys.arrow: just off the string, tip a short way right of the bow
keys.notes: loose — detach key, arrow leaves string

keys.name: end
keys.archer: relaxed follow-through, draw arm swung back and down, bow nearly straight
keys.arrow: far right edge of frame, high of bow height
